_comment: CA002 - Block legacy authentication. Applies to: the Halden Microsoft Entra ID tenant (P2, lab only). Legacy protocols (IMAP/POP/SMTP AUTH, Exchange ActiveSync and other clients) cannot present MFA and are a common credential-abuse path, so they are blocked rather than challenged. Deployed by 07-New-ConditionalAccessPolicies.ps1, report-only first. Token __BREAKGLASS_UPNS__ is replaced at deploy time.
